description: Vectorized NumPy array access for clump pebble attributes.

functions.name: extra
functions.signature: itasca.pebblearray.extra(slot: int) -> array float{pebble} or float{pebble,3}
functions.description: Get the pebble extra data in the given slot as an array. Extra variables accessed by array must be of type float or vec.

examples.code:
import itasca as it
values = it.pebblearray.extra(1)
examples.description: Read extra slot 1 for every object.

notes: Array APIs operate on all current objects of this type and return or accept NumPy arrays with the shape shown in the signature.
Array extra variables must be float or vector values in the selected slot.

functions.name: fill_pos
functions.description: Fill an existing array with the pebble location. The array must be the correct shape.

examples.code:
import numpy as np
import itasca as it
data = np.empty_like(it.pebblearray.pos())
it.pebblearray.fill_pos(data)
examples.description: Fill a preallocated NumPy array to avoid allocating a new result array.

notes: Array APIs operate on all current objects of this type and return or accept NumPy arrays with the shape shown in the signature.
The destination array must already have the correct shape and dtype.

functions.name: fill_radius
functions.description: Fill an existing array with the pebble radii. The array must be the correct shape.

examples.code:
import numpy as np
import itasca as it
data = np.empty_like(it.pebblearray.radius())
it.pebblearray.fill_radius(data)
examples.description: Fill a preallocated NumPy array to avoid allocating a new result array.

notes: Array APIs operate on all current objects of this type and return or accept NumPy arrays with the shape shown in the signature.
The destination array must already have the correct shape and dtype.
One value per pebble (the Itasca page writes {ball}).

functions.name: set_extra
functions.signature: itasca.pebblearray.set_extra(slot: int, data: array float{pebble} or float{pebble, 3}) -> None
functions.description: Set the pebble extra data in the given slot with an array. Extra variables set by array must be of type float or vec.

examples.code:
import numpy as np
import itasca as it
it.pebblearray.set_extra(1, np.zeros(len(it.pebblearray.ids())))
examples.description: Write a float into extra slot 1 for every object.

notes: Array APIs operate on all current objects of this type and return or accept NumPy arrays with the shape shown in the signature.
Setter functions modify model state immediately.
Array extra variables must be float or vector values in the selected slot.

functions.name: set_group
functions.signature: itasca.pebblearray.set_group(membership: array bool{pebble}, group_name: str, slot=1) -> None
functions.description: Set pebble group from an array. Where membership True set the corresponding pebble to be a member of group group_name in the given slot.

examples.code:
import itasca as it
mask = it.pebblearray.pos()[:, 2] > 0.0
it.pebblearray.set_group(mask, 'upper')
examples.description: Put the objects above z = 0 into group 'upper'.

notes: Array APIs operate on all current objects of this type and return or accept NumPy arrays with the shape shown in the signature.
Setter functions modify model state immediately.

functions.name: set_pos
functions.description: Set the pebble location from an array.

examples.code:
import itasca as it
data = it.pebblearray.pos()
# modify data in place, then write it back
it.pebblearray.set_pos(data)
examples.description: Read, modify and write back pos for every object.

notes: Array APIs operate on all current objects of this type and return or accept NumPy arrays with the shape shown in the signature.
Setter functions modify model state immediately.
